_about: The named points ('attachments') of Ronin's body file that this skin moves.  Hand-authored.
They only decide where the game draws something that hangs on the titan; every other point, and everything
else that is not mesh, stays exactly as in the stock file (the build checks this point by point).
Where the sword is drawn while it is put away.  Ronin hangs it on a point at the left of its rear hull; the
Takemikazuchi carries it in the blade holder on its back.  Project MIKHAIL's model has a point on each holder
where that game lays a stowed weapon (Bm_mount_L / Bm_mount_R for blades, Gm_mount_L / Gm_mount_R for guns).
The sword's own grip marker is laid on the right blade holder's point, with no adjustment: grip up above the
shoulder, blade straight down through the clamp, edge to the rear - the pose in the game's own artwork.
(The same marker on the left holder's point stands the blade upward; that game mirrors the left side.)
carried_along: Ronin keeps two more points on the stowed sword, at its tip and edge, used for effects; they
move with it.  Each is the named in-hand point carried onto the holster.
